exercises.text: 260. *设谐振动$f_1(t)=A_1\cos(\omega t+\varphi_1)$，$f_2(t)=A_2\cos(\omega t+\varphi_2)$的和可以写成$f_1(t)+f_2(t)=A\cos(\omega t+\varphi)$。证明：$A=\sqrt{A_1^2+A_2^2+2A_1A_2\cos(\varphi_2-\varphi_1)}$，$\operatorname{tg}\frac{\varphi}{2}=\frac{A_1\sin\varphi_1+A_2\sin\varphi_2}{A+A_1\cos\varphi_1+A_2\cos\varphi_2}$。
